arm_b.definition: successive legal primitive edits sampled from the legal Active8 fiber, the fiber RECOMPUTED after every intermediate, with the planned length taken from the unchanged arm-A synthesis for that same proposal
arm_b.name: length_matched_legal_chains

budget_note: Arm A's dominant wave ran budget 1008 and its third seeds 1000 (or a 10k prefix). The controller policy provably never reads remaining budget -- charged_calls_per_task enters only ProgramQueryLedger's stop condition and the AUC denominator -- so trajectories are comparable. BOTH arms are reported at exactly 1000 charged calls from the ledger prefix.

chain_arm_uniformity_definition.DEFINITION: uniform over DISTINCT CANONICAL SUCCESSORS, not over native marks
chain_arm_uniformity_definition.measured_cost: ~3.6 s per chain step on a real 48-slot PMO state (full fiber ~471 successors)
chain_arm_uniformity_definition.not_constructed_by: shuffling or replaying a compiled program
chain_arm_uniformity_definition.why_this_is_the_definition: enumerate_rule_successors applies each candidate action through the editing-V2 rewrite system, computes canonical_state_key(successor), drops the source key and any duplicate key, and returns one LegalSuccessor per distinct canonical successor. Several native marks landing on one molecule are therefore collapsed to a single draw. This is stated BEFORE any arm-B run and must not be changed afterwards.

charged_call_accounting.authoritative_charged_count: resolved oracle receipts: oracle/query_NNNNNN/ directories containing result.json, which is exactly ProgramQueryLedger.rows
charged_call_accounting.consequence: the 988 figure that looked like a shortfall on the exactly-1000-receipt seed is a lagging snapshot, not missing evaluations; all 18 arm-A seeds supply >=1000 charged evaluations
charged_call_accounting.do_not_use: progress.json:charged_oracle_calls -- it is a PER-ROUND SNAPSHOT that lags the final calls
charged_call_accounting.receipts_vs_charged_note: the albuterol 20261923 run shows 5991 receipts against 5975 charged in its own progress snapshot; the prefix is taken on resolved receipts, so the two never have to be reconciled by subtraction
charged_call_accounting.reporting_prefix: the first 1000 RESOLVED receipts in charge (index) order, for BOTH arms

known_asymmetries_to_disclose: there is NO learned rate model on the scored PMO path (verified: zero torch.load / rate-model instantiation in the import closure), so the 'frozen local reference' for the chain arm is the uniform law over the legal Active8 fiber, not a learned R_theta

the jump lane reads a teacher-derived plan library (diagnostics/pmo_joint_dependency_jump_gate_v1/attempt_2/checkpoints.json, fit_scope shared_all_routes) that the chain arm has no analogue for; measured footprint is ~0.39% of attempts

the credit feature vector carries one-hot indicators for shallow/structured/jump channels; anchored and transplant already encode as all-zero, so a chain proposal inherits an existing valid encoding rather than a novel missing-feature penalty
protocol: no-prescreen PMO, task-independent initialization bank, endpoint-only oracle scoring
question: Do structured programs outperform learned local editing when the planned editing allowance is matched?
retain_all: all six objectives and all three seeds are reported regardless of outcome

scored_closure_identity.claim: every arm-A run is byte-identical on the scored PMO import closure
scored_closure_identity.method: import closure of compose_v4.experiments.pmo_population_v1 taken by execution, intersected with git diff --name-only between each commit pair

seed_rule: arm B uses the SAME three seeds per task that arm A used, so initialization is matched per seed; the triples were recovered by reproducing the published table to three decimals, not chosen on score
